Zoo Events

Adventure Days

March 22 | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
 June 28 | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
 September 20 | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
 December 20 | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Join us and the Chattanooga Public Library for a fun series of Adventure Days at Chattanooga Zoo! On the dates listed above, all Chattanooga Public Library card holders ages 18 and under will get FREE admission to the Zoo, plus hands-on activities provided by your favorite library. Make sure to bring your library card to the ticket booth!

On each Adventure Day, a librarian will host story time at 11 a.m. and 12 p.m.

ticket information

  • Admission is free for Chattanooga Public Library Card Holders ages 18 and under.

    Please bring your library card to the ticket booth. Those who are over 18 years old and/or do not have a library card will need to pay normal Zoo admission.
